Test Case 3: Verify No Invalid Backend Parameter

Input:
- File: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/session/template-metrics-client.ts
- Check: callMCPTool arguments object

Expected Output:
- No 'backend' parameter in arguments
- Only valid parameters: activity_id, result

Validation:
- Parse file for callMCPTool arguments object
- Check if 'backend' parameter exists in arguments
- Verify 'backend' is NOT present

PASS Criteria:
- No 'backend' parameter found in callMCPTool arguments

FAIL Criteria:
- 'backend' parameter found (e.g., backend: 'all')
- Any reference to 'backend' in arguments object
